Actor and RJ Divya Vinekar Dies Suddenly

Divya Vinekar, an actor and RJ, has died suddenly. She was known for her role as a constable in the film 'Darlings', which starred Alia Bhatt. Vinekar also had roles in films and digital media, and worked in digital marketing.
